definitions.explanation: the defeat or rejection of a proposal or bill through voting

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{否決|ひけつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{否決|ひけつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The proposal was rejected by a majority opposing it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修正案|しゅうせいあん}→修正案：22938_shuuseian⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{否決|ひけつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{原案|げんあん}→原案：11978_genan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: With the amendment rejected, the original proposal was passed as is.

notes:
{否決|ひけつ} means to reject a proposal or bill by vote. Combines {否|ひ} (negate) + {決|けつ} (decide).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{否決|ひけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to vote down a bill
- ⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{否決|ひけつ}: rejected by majority opposition
- ⟦{満場|まんじょう}{一致|いっち}→満場一致：28977_manjouicchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{否決|ひけつ}: rejected unanimously
- {否決|ひけつ}{権|けん}: veto power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧: passage, approval (antonym) — {否決|ひけつ} and ⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧ form a natural pair
- ⟦{却下|きゃっか}→却下：05908_kyakka⟧: rejection, dismissal — used in legal/administrative contexts, not necessarily by vote
- ⟦{棄却|ききゃく}→棄却：05965_kikyaku⟧: dismissal — primarily legal (e.g., dismissing a case)

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in political, parliamentary, and corporate governance contexts.
